authorization: User approved separately named route A amendment by proceed on 2026-09-19
scope: Single-seam GPT-2 adaptation qualified by C-A; not published original-setting reproduction

matrix.evaluation_documents: the same 256 fixed held-out documents as v3 (frozen_inputs of v3 apply unchanged)
matrix.aux_corpus: C-A fresh 112-article/15604-window disjoint auxiliary corpus; pending artifact pins

primary.contrast: bisr_bre_bf minus joint_true_k32, paired within victim run (attack seeds averaged first)
primary.interpretation: Two-sided adapted-algorithm comparison at declared distinct budgets; no original-setting or equal-compute claim.

secondary_contrasts: bisr_bre_bf vs forward_k32 (both depths, both knowledge conditions)
bisr_bre_bf vs sipit_128 (both depths, both knowledge conditions)
bisr_sip vs forward_k32 (isolates the stage-2 BRE contribution)
bisr_bre_bf vs joint_true_k32 at L=3 public and both exact-knowledge cells

statistics.unit: crossed document and independently trained victim run; average attack seeds first
statistics.secondary_correction: Bonferroni percentile bootstrap intervals across all prespecified secondary contrasts
statistics.pairing: BiSR cells pair to v3 cells on (victim seed, depth, knowledge, attack seed, document); the v3 published numbers are the frozen controls and are NOT re-run
statistics.missing: No complete-case deletion. Any missing/failed cell blocks comparative analysis; retain failure and rerun in a fresh directory with the same protocol.
statistics.stopping: Exactly 256 fixed evaluation documents and 10 victim seeds; no outcome-driven sample extension.

algorithm.auxiliary: C-A fresh 112-article/15604-window disjoint auxiliary corpus; pending artifact pins
algorithm.claims: No equal-compute claim; continuous BRE and k32 control have distinct measured budgets

gradient_conversion.reason: Original capture CE sum divided by 256*(sequence_length-1); recover per-document mean CE gradient. This is a loss-normalisation factor, not capture batch size.

gates: All original input and grant hashes verified
Exact-head replay and public downstream isolation
Fresh seed17/29 GRUs, trained mechanical gates
Final manifest binds all inputs, source, environment and checkpoints
Resource canary and total budget admission

sasa.role: CPU frozen controls and complete-set statistics
